_comment: channel-autoweight configuration. Every threshold lives here. Copy to config.json and fill in the site-specific values (or use AUTOWEIGHT_* environment variables).
_comment_probe_token_ids: token ids (logs.token_id) used by the probe key; their rows are excluded from real-user metrics. No key material here.

rank._comment: Rank-based tiers: leader gets top_w; score ratio >= close_ratio gets top_w*close_factor; >= mid_ratio gets mid_w; the rest low_w. All within tie_ratio -> uniform.

proportional._comment: Alternative strategy for comparison: weight proportional to score^gamma.

score._comment: score = (1-err)^err_exp * (1-slow) * latency_factor; latency_factor = t_ref/(t_ref + a*p50 + b*p90 + c*ttft). See README for every sub-feature.

soft_caps._comment: Per-channel soft caps {channel_id: {cap, enabled, reason, relax}}. A capped channel is flagged as a quality risk.

probe._comment: Active first-token probe through the public gateway. The key comes from AUTOWEIGHT_PROBE_KEY, a local key file, or a remote key file; it is never logged.
probe.prompt: Write about 200 words explaining why the sky is blue. Output the text only.

recovery._comment: Observation cap for a channel that just resumed streaming after buffered rounds.

watch._comment: Watch list: disabled/suspicious channels that are probed and reported only (no scoring, no writes).

trust._comment: Trust: slow rise, fast fall. Bad events multiply trust by (1-down*severity); clean rounds add up*min(1, n60/up_full_n); score *= floor+(1-floor)*trust.

shadow._comment: Shadow mode: compute suggestions every interval_min minutes, read-only, never writes to the DB.

score_smooth._comment: Asymmetric score smoothing (worse follows immediately, better rises slowly). Off by default.

rise_confirm._comment: Weight increases need confirmation by the last n shadow suggestions. Off by default.

trust_cap._comment: Low-trust cap: channels with trust < thr (and 1h samples < max_n60) get at most cap.

newcomer._comment: Newcomer cap: channels are discovered from the DB; a channel stays 'new' until it has enough formal rounds and real traffic, capped at cap with an exploration floor explore_w.

capacity._comment: Known concurrency limits {channel_id: {max_conc, reason}}: cap the traffic share against the estimated peak total concurrency.

log_stream_veto._comment: Veto a probe 'buffered' verdict when real streaming traffic in the logs shows the channel streams fine.

small_sample._comment: Cap any channel with too few real 1h requests. Off by default.

reenable._comment: Diagnostics for disabled channels the operator allowed to be re-attached {channel_id: {disabled_at, vendor?, ...}}. Diagnostics only.

toggle._comment: Autonomous on/off: suggest disabling persistently worst / erroring channels and re-enabling recovered ones, with floors min_enabled / hard_min.
